notes.title: [Major update] weapon addition+Chinese addition
notes.notes:
[b] Thank you [/b]

Thank you for your support for the Double-Line Fight series. We have made simplified Chinese for the Double-Line Fight New World. This update will systematically repair the game to ensure that you can get a good game experience

[b] Update as follows [/b]

1. The collision volume of the gun has been repaired to prevent mold piercing

2. Add a new super sniper gun: SVD, which requires 35mm bullets, and each clip contains five bullets

3. Fixed bug in online mode

4. New character: commander

5. Map lighting optimization

6. Select persona interface optimization

7. Legendary figure's new cape

8. Ranking optimization

9. Simplified Chinese has been added to the game

notes.title: Small update content on February 13, 2023
notes.notes:
Small update content on February 13, 2023
After a week of development, our product officially said goodbye to beta 1.2 and entered 1.3. Here are our updates
Game updates
1. The flamethrower can ignite the corpse and cause continuous damage to the enemy
2. Add AKS assault rifle
3. The afterglow of combustion is enhanced
4. AI roaming
5. Enhancement of night vision ability
6. Modify the character's sprint action
7. The rendering hardware of flame is changed from GPU to CPU
8. Many BUG problems
9. AI name base enhancement

notes.title: 2023/2/4 update announcement
notes.notes:
[h2] Update Summary [/h2]

1. Fix the distance from the player's camera to the weapon

2. Solve the problem of mercenaries stuck in mid-air

3. The main character's lateral ability is greatly weakened

4. Increase of supply points in the map

5. AI enhancement

6. The weapon is added with the Remington M870 shotgun, and the initial sniper gun of the protagonist is slightly enhanced

7. The second form of night vision instrument (azimuth perspective) is weakened, and there is a chance that the enemy can not be perspective

8. Increase of merchant points

9. Taskbar item redo

10. Add a large number of supplies and their use actions

11. Game gun feel optimization

12. Many problems

[h2] Version features [/h2]

The biggest feature of this version is the increase of war supplies. After all, the difficulty of this game is very high. The protagonist has only 100 points of life, but our protagonist's ability will be improved after using the supplies. For example, canned pork can improve the value of blood regeneration, chocolate can improve the maximum life, and soda can reduce the interval between players' blood regeneration

[h2] Season theme [/h2]

Our current version of the game is beta 1.0. We officially entered beta 1.1 on February 4. I hope you can come and play happily, just like the title of the war, let your footprints cover the new battlefield!
